detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A glowing transparent blue energy shield hovers in a dark room. A bullet strikes it once and a ripple of light spreads across it. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: Foley recording, close microphone, isolated sound: one single glassy crystal tink with a short shimmering electric ring, then silence. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
